name: Andron Gant
summary: In the Undercity's Apothecarium, Andron Gant handles occasional commissions and relic recoveries for local scholars. He is a reclusive Forsaken, often drunk, and rarely leaves the city.

sections.title: A Slurring Recluse
sections.body: Andron Gant spends his time in the Apothecarium, among its noxious fumes, and rarely ventures beyond the Undercity's stone walls. He seems little more than a drunken scholar. For local mages, he sometimes hires couriers to seek obscure relics on distant shores, including the Tablet of Markri.

sections.title: Unmasked by the Deathstalkers
sections.body: The Undercity's intelligence network noticed Gant's treacherous dealings. The Syndicate sent Astor Hadren to collect a ledger of compromised data, but aspiring Deathstalker operatives intercepted the courier. One agent took Hadren's place and tricked the drunken Gant into handing over the incriminating ledger without raising suspicion. The ledger gave Lord Varimathras definitive proof of Gant's treason against the Forsaken.

faq.q: Where can I find Andron Gant?
faq.answer: Andron Gant can be found in the lower levels of the Apothecarium district, inside the Undercity.

faq.q: Why is Andron Gant interested in Azshara tablets?
faq.answer: Gant arranges payments for certain Undercity mages, sending scavengers and contacts such as Jediga to recover ancient relics from the ruins of Azshara.

faq.q: Why do the Deathstalkers investigate Andron Gant?
aliases: who does andron gant work for
faq.answer: The Deathstalkers investigate Gant's dealings with outside contacts and seek intelligence about his research commissions.

faq.q: Who directs the investigation into Andron Gant?
faq.answer: The Deathstalkers investigate Gant on behalf of Lord Varimathras, seeking intelligence about his contacts and research.

angles.text: As a Forsaken rogue, you learn while rising through the Deathstalkers that the Undercity's halls demand as much vigilance as its borders.
As an Undead, you may know Gant as a familiar sight in the Apothecarium: a drunken Forsaken who rarely leaves the city and brokers odd errands for its mages.
